scenes.headline: How an 8B model learns in three states
scenes.sub: Neutrino-1 trains ternary weights from the first gradient step.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Baklava! Neutrino-1 is an eight-billion-parameter model built from weights that are only minus, zero or plus. Here's how.

scenes.text: Don't round a finished model into ternary. Train inside the three-state format from the first gradient step, so the model that trains is the model that ships.
scenes.say: The idea: don't round a finished model into three states. Train inside them from the first step, so what trains is what ships.

left.title: Round after training
items: Each weight snaps to the nearest state
Errors walk along the row instead of cancelling
left.say: Round a trained model afterward, and the errors don't cancel. They walk along each row, and thirty-six layers compound them.

right.title: Train inside the format
items: The optimizer only ever sees three states
It never learns what the format can't store
No gap between trained and shipped
right.say: Train inside the format, and the optimizer never learns a solution the format can't store.

parts.note: one higher-precision scale per block of weights
parts.say: Weights are grouped into blocks, and each block keeps its own higher-precision scale.

parts.note: divide by the block's scale, clip to minus one…one
parts.say: Divide a weight by its block's scale, and clip it to between minus one and one.

parts.note: snap to minus, zero or plus
parts.say: Round it: minus, zero or plus.

parts.note: the layer computes with state times scale
parts.say: The layer then computes with state times scale.

scenes.title: What is ternary, and what isn't

steps.say: A token climbs thirty-six decoder layers, each with seven projection matrices.
All two hundred and fifty-two are ternary. Each output sums hundreds of three-state terms, and that sum is what makes the format survivable.

steps.note: no sum to average the error away
steps.say: The embedding and output head stay int8. A lookup returns one row verbatim, and the head decides by small logit margins.

steps.label: A float layer: every connection stays
steps.say: A float layer can only make a connection small.

steps.label: 62.63% of the 8B's ternary weights are zero
steps.say: A ternary layer can delete it outright. Sixty-two point six three percent of the weights end up zero, and training decides which.

scenes.title: 5-shot MMLU, same ternary format
scenes.note: self-reported by Fermion; no third-party replication found
scenes.say: On five-shot MMLU, as Fermion reports it: rounded afterward lands on the chance line. Trained inside, seventy-two point one.

scenes.text: Quantization format is something you commit to before training starts, not a knob you turn afterward.

recap: Trained in three states from the first step
Each weight is a state times its block's scale
Embeddings and head stay int8; zeros are learned
scenes.say: To recap: three states from step one, a scale per block, and learned zeros.
